answer: Producing a novel, coherent answer each epoch is cheap per alias but prohibitive across thousands, so scale buys less credibility — the attacker cannot simply buy a large, credible flock. So the design does not rely on catching every cheat — it makes cheating unprofitable, which is a far more stable defense than any whitelist ever could be.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a plume as the anchor of the cost.
